notes.title: Demo now available on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Ascend The Dome is joining the Steam Next Fest starting this June 9th!

Among the many participating titles, Ascend The Dome stands out — and its first DEMO is already available for download on its Steam page under the name "Ascend The Dome DEMO"!

The demo features a single, smaller dome compared to the full game, but it’s packed with content and climbing challenges! Some of the trials include Kart Parkour, Sisyphus Golf, The Backroom, and Skyblock!

In addition, the demo offers all four official game modes:


Normal Mode
Time Trial Mode
Speedrun Mode


Stream-Chat Game Mode

You can even connect your Twitch stream and let your viewers interact with the game — they’ll be able to mess with you live while you climb!

For speedrunners, the global Steam leaderboard is already up and running!

Enjoy the game now!
If you like it, don’t forget to leave a review sharing your experience and any suggestions for the final version! <3 ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Stream chat gamemode!
notes.content:
Ascend the Dome comes with a game mode that lets your Twitch chat interact with you live during your stream!

This mode lets your chat mess with your run live on stream! Add custom commands with real in-game effects. With Bits and subs, they can make your climb way harder—think shoves, ragdolls, screen blur, wild VFX, time warps (slow-mo or hyperspeed), slippery ice floors, and tons more chaos!

Would you rather? Rogue-like

Take on challenges with your community when you have to choose between different in-game perks that boost your climb—while your chat tries to make it harder! How about unlocking double jump for gifting 5 subs? Enjoy unique power-ups in this mode like jetpacks, slow-mo control, or a glider!
